name: にぎやかな店の中
description: This is a store. A woman is standing in front of the checkout counter. A basket is on the checkout counter. A man is carrying a box toward the counter. A girl is standing between a shopping cart and a shelf. A man is looking at his phone in the middle of the store. A bag is on the floor next to the cart. A red apple is on the shelf.
